notes:
CRM snapshot: potential enterprise customer evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for production inference. Primary ask: full KMS/HSM integration and BYOK flow across AWS, Azure, GCP with clear custody semantics. Key requirements:
- BYOK import + envelope encryption (customer retains root key).
- Hardware-backed keys preferred: CloudHSM / AWS KMS with multi-tenant HSM attestations OR Azure Dedicated HSM. FIPS 140-2 evidence required.
- Support for AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault (and HSM), Google Cloud KMS, and an on-prem PKCS#11 connector for future air-gapped sites.
- Redwood must provide architecture diagram showing where plaintext keys are handled (Lumina insists: Redwood never hold plaintext master key).
- Audit log forwarding: must push KMS and Redwood control-plane audit logs to Lumina SIEM (Splunk). Retention policy 7 years for specific event types.
- Data residency: primary production in us-east-1; EU read-only replicas for EU customers. Must support per-tenant key residency & KMS keys scoped to region.
- Key rotation: automated rotation policy for data-encrypting keys; manual control for master keys. Separation of duties: SE/ops vs legal.
- Network: strict VPC peering, no public egress for inference traffic, egress exceptions for KMS control plane endpoints only via controlled NAT.
- Fallbacks: deterministic routing to smaller model variants when dedicated capacity not available; fallback must still honor KMS encryption boundaries.
POC notes: current POC showed model serving latency within target for baseline traffic, pending scale test with real key wrapping flows. Legal has pushed back on custody text in SOW: prefer customer-managed HSM with Redwood acting only on key-ID/reference. Next deliverables: updated crypto architecture, KMS integration runbook, sample IAM policies, and scoped SOW changes addressing BYOK custody.
Direct quote from Head of Security: "We need to be certain our root keys never leave our control — show us the envelope flow and the audit trail."
Short hand / action items: get FIPS certs, prepare PKCS#11 connector spec, confirm log forwarding retention, update SOW BYOK clause, schedule procurement review (Apr).
